hints.title: Cumulative Subarray Difference
hints.text: Multiple subarray sum queries must be answered over a static array. Computing running cumulative totals during initialization allows any range sum to be computed in constant time.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Array Initialization
hints.text: Build an array prefix of size N + 1 where prefix[i] stores the sum of the first i elements. Notice prefix[0] is 0.

hints.title: Constant-Time Range Query Formula
hints.text: The sum of elements between indices left and right inclusive equals prefix[right + 1] - prefix[left].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) initialization, O(1) per sumRange query
variables: N: length of nums array (1 <= N <= 10^4)
complexity.notes: Initial cumulative prefix sum pass enables instant O(1) query lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Summing elements on each query costs O(N) per query, leading to O(N * Q) time and timeout over 10,000 queries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Trading O(N) auxiliary memory for the prefix array reduces query latency to O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of 1-based indexing for the prefix array to eliminate conditional boundary branching.
